name: no-echo
description: Decision skills where opposed viewpoints argue one question and the dissent is kept: let-them-fight, rewrite-or-regret, but-should-we and what-could-go-wrong, with a read-only council seat agent. And story-or-snore, which turns the pitch into a story people stay awake for, with a script that checks the story still fits the facts. Formerly the council plugin.
